Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
2:49 PM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays.

Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card.

The site lists the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries as closed for renovation. That notice is dated 29 May 2023, so call ahead if those are your reason for going.
